scenarios.name: inspector-500-fields
scenarios.equivalent: 500 rows alternating NumberField and TextField, each with its side label (no Field row component yet)

scenarios.name: virtual-list-10000
scenarios.equivalent: List over 10,000 ListRow rows, one selected row

scenarios.name: sheet-50x200
scenarios.description: a sheet of 50 x 200 visible cells as row parts
scenarios.equivalent: BenchList of 200 rows, each with 50 cell parts that paint their text

scenarios.name: canvas-50-controls
scenarios.equivalent: a leaf with 50 control parts painted as knobs

scenarios.name: menu-40-rows
scenarios.equivalent: a container on the menu layer, open from the first frame, over a List of 40 ListRow rows

scenarios.name: text-field-100kb
scenarios.description: a 100 KB multi-line text field, bound
scenarios.equivalent: TextField::lines(30) bound with Bind::bound over a 100 KB String

scenarios.name: list-10000-selected
scenarios.equivalent: List over 10,000 ListRow rows, all 10,000 keys in the Selection

scenarios.name: collapse-in-content-sized-panel
scenarios.description: a collapse animating inside a content-sized panel
scenarios.equivalent: a content-sized, animated-collapse container whose open state the scene toggles

scenarios.name: auto-height-list-scroll-10000
scenarios.equivalent: List over 10,000 ListRow rows of one to four row heights (detail line and wrapped lines on three in four), mouse wheel every frame

scenarios.name: second-viewport
scenarios.equivalent: a container with Mount::viewport (the fallback layer, as under an embedded backend)

scenarios.name: dialog-20-fields
scenarios.description: a modal dialog open over 20 fields
scenarios.equivalent: a modal Dialog open from the first frame over 10 NumberFields and 10 TextFields

scenarios.name: readout-and-content-column
scenarios.description: an end-aligned readout and a Content grid column changing every frame
scenarios.equivalent: two labelled TextFields in a ColumnGroup whose label text changes width every frame, and an end-aligned readout block
